1.t: A questioner questioned concerning the doom about to fall

2.t: Upon the disbelievers, which none can repel,

3.t: From Allah, Lord of the Ascending Stairways

4.t: (Whereby) the angels and the Spirit ascend unto Him in a Day whereof the span is fifty thousand years.

5.t: But be patient (O Muhammad) with a patience fair to see.

6.t: Lo! they behold it afar off

8.t: The day when the sky will become as molten copper,

9.t: And the hills become as flakes of wool,

10.t: And no familiar friend will ask a question of his friend

11.t: Though they will be given sight of them. The guilty man will long to be able to ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children

12.t: And his spouse and his brother

13.t: And his kin that harboured him

14.t: And all that are in the earth, if then it might deliver him.

15.t: But nay! for lo! it is the fire of hell

17.t: It calleth him who turned and fled (from truth),

21.t: And, when good befalleth him, grudging;

23.t: Who are constant at their worship

24.t: And in whose wealth there is a right acknowledged

25.t: For the beggar and the destitute;

26.t: And those who believe in the Day of Judgment,

27.t: And those who are fearful of their Lord's doom -

28.t: Lo! the doom of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure -

29.t: And those who preserve their chastity

30.t: Save with their wives and those whom their right hands possess, for thus they are not blameworthy;

31.t: But whoso seeketh more than that, those are they who are transgressors;

32.t: And those who keep their pledges and their covenant,

33.t: And those who stand by their testimony

34.t: And those who are attentive at their worship.

35.t: These will dwell in Gardens, honoured.

36.t: What aileth those who disbelieve, that they keep staring toward thee (O Muhammad), open-eyed,

37.t: On the right and on the left, in groups?

38.t: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?

39.t: Nay, verily. Lo! We created them from what they know.

40.t: But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the planets that We verily are Able

41.t: To replace them by (others) better than them. And we are not to be outrun.

42.t: So let them chat and play until they meet their Day which they are promised,

43.t: The day when they come forth from the graves in haste, as racing to a goal,

44.t: With eyes aghast, abasement stupefying them: Such is the Day which they are promised.
